tick_interval.description: Heartbeat tick interval as a Go duration string (e.g. '5s').

max_concurrent_events.description: Soft ceiling on concurrent bus dispatches; 0 = unbounded.

agent_id.description: Per-agent storage partition key. Empty collapses ScopeAgent to ScopeApp.

id_format.description: Session ID format: timestamp | datetime_short | uuid.

object_store.description: Optional remote object store that is the source of truth for a session between runs. Absent or with an empty backend, no object-store code runs.

backend.description: Name of a registered object-store backend. Registration is by blank import of the backend module; an unregistered name fails the boot.

bucket.description: Bucket / container the backend writes to. Required when backend is set. Nexus never creates it.

prefix.description: Object key prefix within the bucket. An object key, not a filesystem path — no ~ expansion, no leading or trailing '/'.

region.description: Backend region, where the backend needs one.

endpoint.description: Override the default service endpoint. This is what makes S3-compatible stores (MinIO, R2, Ceph) and local emulators reachable.

credentials_file.description: Path to a static credentials file (~/... allowed). Empty means ambient credentials — workload identity, instance role, environment.

failure_policy.description: What happens when state cannot be persisted. 'degrade' (default) keeps the session running against the local copy; 'strict' fails the turn.

models.description: Named model roles (default, reasoning, balanced, ...). Free-form per role.

drain_timeout.description: Maximum wall-clock the engine waits for in-flight bus dispatches to drain on Stop. Go duration string (e.g. '30s').

enabled.description: When true, the CLI starts an fsnotify watcher on the -config path and calls Engine.ReloadConfig on edits. Default false; SIGHUP and the browser admin endpoint remain available regardless.

debounce.description: Collapse fsnotify bursts within this window into one reload. Go duration string (e.g. '1s'). Default 1s.

active.description: Ordered list of active plugin IDs (instance-suffixed forms supported).

fsync.description: Disk-flush policy for the durable journal.

exclude_events.description: Event types the journal must not record. Bus still dispatches them to subscribers; only durable logging is suppressed. Defaults to ["core.tick"]. Set to [] to disable exclusion entirely.
